title: Teddy
body:
Trade-only
This item is no longer available unless by means of trading with another player.

Reason: It is a limited item obtainable on Valetines Day

“Squishy! Caution: May be pink”

Description

The Teddy is a decoration item that is no longer available for purchase. The item was sold at The Oak Depot for $776 and was added for a limited time as part of Version 1.3.0 (The Valentine's Day update).

It normally comes in brown when unboxed; however, there is a 1-in-10 chance for it to be pink.

The Pink Teddy has an additional “Pat” option, which will play one of a few possible voice lines, saying one of the following: “I need a hug,” “I love you,” “I love spending time with you,” “Let’s be friends” or “Will you be my friend?”

Appearance

The Teddy is a small light brown teddy bear with black eyes. The model used for it is the Roblox gear item "Teddy Bloxpin."

The Pink Teddy is the same as the normal one, except it takes on a unique pink texture with a red heart on its chest.

Trivia

  • This was one of the first items to have a rare variant.
